description_en: Queries a list of control policies
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-policies --instance-id bastionhost-cn-5yd393wzk08 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPolicies

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.
Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page. We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the control policy to query. Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的控制策略名称。仅支持精确查询
parameters.name: policy_name

Comment.description_en: The remarks of the control policy

PolicyName.description_en: The name of the control policy

Priority.description_en: The priority of the control policy. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Priority.description_zh: 控制策略的优先级，数字越小优先级越高

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of control policies that are returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的控制策略总数量
